profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. On its own site, the company describes itself as providing AI automation for critical business processes at large organizations, and says it orchestrates AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. It states that it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and describes itself as a Leader in Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies.

The site presents the Appian Platform as the place where customers build AI-powered processes, with pages covering process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy application modernization. It lists uses including accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier management, low-code app building with embedded AI agents, audit and compliance workflows, case resolution, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order fulfillment, and contract review. The company also cites a Gartner assessment of 20 BOAT vendors and an AI value study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The held record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It does note law exposure in Virginia, with a count of 152.
